newsitem.title: ISRAEL: UBS said to weigh joining Tel Aviv bourse.
newsitem.headline: UBS said to weigh joining Tel Aviv bourse.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland recently asked the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange to check the possibility of becoming a full member of the bourse, Israel's Haaretz newspaper said on Thursday.
There are now no foreign members of the exchange.
TASE officials, the UBS representative in Israel and UBS officials in London were not immediately available to comment.
Haaretz quoted an unnamed UBS manager in London as saying of the report: "It is still too early to talk about the subject, a decision has yet to be taken."
Haaretz said the TASE had decided to change some procedures to allow quick acceptance of UBS as a full member.

It said UBS, among the largest foreign players in Israel, was expected to open an office there soon and the first step was its request for TASE membership to enable it to act directly on behalf of its clients.
